programme.title: Henry Danger: Misundelsesmuren
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen holder vagt ved Swellviews nyeste attraktion, Misundelsesmuren, da Kaptajn Mand ødelægger muren i et forsøg på at eliminere en lille fugl. Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand må nu finde en måde at erstatte den på.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hr. Flinkofyr
programme.desc: En selvtægtsudøver iklædt en smiley-fjæs-maske straffer indbyggere i Swellview for uhøflig optræden. Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mands undersøgelser leder dem til et TV-studie ejet af den kendte børneprogramsvært hr. Wallabee.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Theranos sko
programme.desc: Henry og de andre ødelægger Rays elskede filmrekvisit, theranos-skoen. Nu må Henry og Jasper rejse til en mandehule i et alternativt univers ved hjælp af Bill Evils interdimensionelle transporter og stjæle deres theranos-sko, før Ray opdager det.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rumblr
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand, som er træt af altid at kæmpe mod de samme skurke, vil lave en profil på en app, som matcher helte og skurke. Faredrengen gør det samme, og nu sætter de to en dobbeltkamp op for at kæmpe mod nogle nye skurke.

programme.title: Henry Danger: En huledate
programme.desc: Henry og gutterne arrangerer en hemmelig undergrundsrestaurant i mandehulen i anledning af Charlottes middag med musiksuperstjernen Jack Swagger. Da rygtet om at Jack Swagger er i byen slipper ud, dukker der nogle uventede gæster op til festen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Telefonernes kamp
programme.desc: Da en ung pige lænker sig selv uden for Skidt og Kanel, tvinges Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand til at hjælpe med at finde hendes telefon. Under en overvågning render de uventet ind i nogle velkendte ansigter med en lusket plan.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Escape Room
programme.desc: Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand bliver luret ind i et escaperoom af en vred og forsmået fabriksejer. De er nu fanget derinde sammen med to nye børn, Mika og Miles, som er overraskende gode til at svare på de gåder, de skal løse for at blive lukket ud.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Begyndelsen på enden
programme.desc: Faredrengen afslører overfor Kaptajn Mand, at han ikke har tænkt sig at sidde fast i Swellview som hans makker for evigt. Situationen bliver ikke forbedret af, at en anden by har rekrutteret Faredrengen som deres helt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Drex
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mands gamle makker og nemesis, Drex, dukker op fra fortiden med en hær af hulemænd for at gøre det af med Kaptajn Mand en gang for alle. Faredrengen er måske den eneste, der nu kan redde Kaptajn Mand.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Faredrengens skæbne: første del
programme.desc: Faredrengen og vennerne forsøger at finde ud af, hvordan de kan få Kaptajn Mand tilbage fra fortiden, mens Drex går videre med sin plan om at udviske Kaptajn Mand fra Swellviews hukommelse for evigt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Social Circle
programme.desc: In 2003, Tiffany Rowell and three of her friends were brutally murdered in affluent Clear Lake, Texas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Low Maintenance
programme.desc: In 2008, college co-ed Jenna Verhaalen was found dead in her Bryan, Texas apartment. Petechial hemorrhages in her eyes indicated that she was strangled.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fate Date
programme.desc: In 2004, Rebecca Barney and her soon-to-be ex-husband Fred were found shot to death in their Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, which had been set on fire.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of a Killer
programme.desc: In 2003, Kathy Lorick was murdered on a Concord, California jogging trail while talking to her husband on her mobile phone.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gone Ballistic
programme.desc: In 2008, the body of Colorado real estate developer Alan Helmick was found by his wife, Miriam, who then became the prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeing Red
programme.desc: In 2005, the body of young mother Summer Baldwin was found in a suitcase in a Texas landfill.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skeleton Key
programme.desc: In 2004, nursing student Tamika Huston went missing from her Spartanburg, South Carolina home. A tip led detectives to her car, where they found an unknown house key that could help solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Funeral Services
programme.desc: In 2002, funeral director Lonnie Turner, Sr. was found shot to death. His son Lonnie Jr. became the prime suspect, particularly after it was discovered that the murder was committed with his gun. However, he had an alibi for the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Expert Witness
programme.desc: In 1993, young mother Tammy Tatum was sexually assaulted and murdered in her Longmont, Colorado apartment. Police initially suspected her estranged husband, but did not have enough evidence to charge him and the case went cold.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Rest In Peace
programme.desc: When an Air Force veteran dies unexpectedly, Kenda and his team must determine if it was a tragic accident or premeditated murder.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Powder Kegs
programme.desc: When uninvited guests crash a barrio birthday party, violence erupts—leaving Enrique Urrutia dead and potentially sparking a gang war.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Collision Course
programme.desc: Two best friends are gunned down on a dark residential street. When a string of disappointments threaten to derail the case, Kenda enlists the help of an old acquaintance.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Pop Goes the Witness
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Willie McCarty is found at the base of a staircase. Neighbors direct Kenda to a truck spotted fleeing the scene, but a surprise visitor at CSPD turns the case on its head.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Rearview Mirror
programme.desc: When a retired military man runs over a pedestrian, it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine if it was bad brakes or bad intent.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living Planet
programme.desc: We have been observing Earth for 40 years now, in the last 20 we have focus with intensity on the planet with new technologies and capabilities, we have accumulated a mass of data that is now revealing a complex and ever changing living planet.

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 2
programme.desc: In this episode, hear first hand testimonials and dialogue from the incredible men who walked on the moon. Incredible footage and photos give a unique and beautiful experience of their data collection process and journey home.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found
programme.desc: Beyond Earth Orbit - The Apollo program takes bold new steps. IXV Re-entry Vehicle - Europe is working to perfect a re-entry vehicle. Galileo Satellites Lost and Found - Navigation satellites go into incorrect orbit.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Space is vast, yet it is full of collisions. Gas and dust electrostatically flock together, and gravity takes over coalescing grains into rocks. Those rocks become boulders, then asteroids colliding again and again, striking planets and each other.

programme.title: The Truth is in the Stars
programme.desc: Does our society have the capacity to live up to Star Trek's optimistic vision for humanity's future? William Shatner takes us on a journey to find out whether art has imitated life in the years since the world-renowned TV series premiered in 1966.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: A Navy lieutenant's death is ruled as arsenic poisoning. Investigators discover he had many enemies.

programme.title: Forensic Files II

programme.title: Forensic Files II

programme.desc: Detectives are determined to do whatever it takes to catch a criminally charged sex offender and murderer.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi laver mad
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie besejrer en berømt tv-kok i en madlavningskonkurrence, vil kokken ikke lave mad mere og nægter at komme ud af sit soveværelse. Spencer prøver at opfylde sin fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: En rektor med karakter
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie får rektor Franklin fyret, overtager miss Briggs og mr. Howard ledelsen og indfører strenge regler. Og Spencer hyrer en gammel rodeostjerne til at lære ham at ride på en mekanisk tyr.

programme.title: iCarly: Find en fyr til Carly
programme.desc: Så mange drenge dukker op til 'tag Carly med til fest'-konkurrencen, at Carly, Sam og Freddie må benytte speed-dating for at møde dem alle sammen. Spencer følger et ejendommeligt træningsprogram fra en ny app.

programme.title: iCarly: Stjernefiasko
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie skal lave en musikvideo til en popstjernes comeback, opdager de, at popstjernen er ude af form og talentløs. Og Spencer opdager, at kvinden, han dater, er Gibbys mor.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg reddede dit liv

programme.title: iCarly: Skønhedskonkurrencen

programme.title: iCarly: Et usædvanligt webshow
programme.desc: Efter Sam pludselig bliver tvunget i fængsel, lover Carly og Freddie ikke at aflyse netshowet, fordi hendes far skal se det. Hun beder Spencer om hjælp, men det bliver svært, for han skal på date.

programme.title: iCarly: Rumvanvid
programme.desc: En pudsig milliardær beder Carly og hendes venner om at sende det første netshow fra rummet, så de bliver testet til en rumrejse. Imens besøger en mærkelig lille pige Spencer.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
